sentiment.rationale: This pre-earnings digest describes depressed expectations heading into the print: LMT shares underperformed peers, trade at a discount to the industry, and the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate was cut 1.4% in the trailing 60 days with a negative Earnings ESP of -1.21%. The lowered bar increases the odds of a positive surprise even on modest results, supporting a mildly bullish score. However, the digest also flags structural bottom-line drags (F-35 TR-3 delays, lower ULA equity earnings), which tempers the score.
